            fy = GRAVITY_COMPENSATION + MAX_THRUST
        elif agent_action.escape_sequence_step <= sum(ESCAPE_PHASES[:2]):
            # Diagonal thrust to break free
            fx = MAX_THRUST * DIAGONAL_SCALE
            fy = GRAVITY_COMPENSATION + MAX_THRUST * DIAGONAL_SCALE
        elif agent_action.escape_sequence_step <= sum(ESCAPE_PHASES):
            # Full forward thrust after diagonal phase
            fx = MAX_THRUST
            fy = GRAVITY_COMPENSATION
        else:
            agent_action.escape_sequence_step = None

        agent_action.stuck_steps = 0

    # Clamp thrust to max allowed
    f = math.hypot(fx, fy)
    if f > MAX_THRUST:
        scale = MAX_THRUST / f
        fx *= scale
        fy *= scale

    sandbox.apply_thrust(fx, fy)
